purpose: Backend registry of reusable blueprints. A blueprint defines the fields, sources, normalization rules, temporal model, relationships and refresh logic inherited by many concrete records.
inheritance_rule: Concrete records store observations and relationships; instructions belong to the parent blueprint.

blueprints.applies_to: religions, traditions and major religious families
denominations, schools, rites and theological movements
political parties, movements and electoral organizations
physical and digital infrastructure assets and networks
technologies, platforms, technical systems and capabilities
cities, settlements, regions, sites and geographic nodes
public leaders, office-holders and historically documented persons
religious, political, cultural, scientific and social movements
texts, datasets, laws, archives, publications and source records
energy, minerals, water, food and ecological resources
ecosystems, watersheds, forests, fisheries and biodiversity systems

promotion_rule: Start a concrete record under the appropriate blueprint. Promote it into canonical nodes when its definition, evidence class, source coverage and graph role are clear.
automation_rule: Blueprints are executable specifications: acquisition jobs read them to discover fields, sources, refresh intervals, validators, derived measures and relationship templates. Missing data is recorded as missing, not silently fabricated.
